prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Sugar Land, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the store entrance, and another car came down the aisle fairly fast.

Q: Which direction were you traveling when the impact occurred?

A: I was backing out slowly, and the other vehicle hit the rear driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming because of a delivery truck parked next to me.

Q: Did you come into contact with anything inside your vehicle?

A: My head hit the side window and the steering wheel pretty hard. I didn't lose consciousness, but I felt dizzy and had a bad headache right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes. An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They told me I have a concussion. I've been told to rest, avoid screens for a while, and not drive until my doctor clears me.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms now?

A: Yes, headaches come and go, I get tired quickly, and bright lights bother my eyes. I've had trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Did the other driver give you any information?

A: They gave me their insurance card and said they were sorry. They said they didn't see my car.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still recovering, and I'd appreciate it if you could keep me updated on the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
